title: v1 consumer stalls after revoke until rebalance timeout
answers: Kafka v1 consumer paused for 20s after partition revoke
ingestion consumer stops consuming after rebalance
body:
Symptom: v1 Kafka consumers stop consuming after a partition revoke and only recover after CONSUMER_REBALANCE_TIMEOUT_MS (20s), logging `rebalancing_timeout_forcing_recovery`.
Root cause: nodejs/src/common/kafka/consumer/consumer-v1.ts:rebalanceCallback set isRebalancing on revoke but only reset it on the next ASSIGN callback (or when assignments().length===0). node-rdkafka delivers assign callbacks only from consume(), and the loop is paused while isRebalancing, so it could never receive them.
Fix pattern: unassign and reset coordination unconditionally in one helper, with the reset in `finally` so a throwing unassign (disconnected consumer) still clears the pause. See consumer-v1.ts:completeRevocation.
Constraints: all revoke paths (tasks done, task error, no tasks) must go through completeRevocation. Do not gate the reset on remaining assignments or on an assign callback.
